patches.name: pi-account-env
patches.description: PI_ACCOUNT_<PROVIDER>=<nome> resolve a credencial pela conta do bucket accounts.json (contas por projeto no ARCA); estrito, refresh sob proper-lockfile; `pi --arca-capabilities` declara suporte.

patches.name: transcript-feedback
patches.description: Transcript rendering, masking and local recap only. No auxiliary inference for recaps or notices.

patches.name: stream-markdown
patches.description: Agrupamento de message_update por quadro no host clássico e PI_TUI_HZ (30..240, default 60), com teto adaptativo. Cache de Markdown e reuso de componentes são upstream Pi 1.5.0.

patches.name: agent-skill-curation
patches.description: PI_AUTOMATIC_SKILLS opt-in: curadoria do anúncio no formatter compartilhado; catálogo e arquivos intactos.

patches.name: codemode-typed-results
patches.description: Structured read/grep/find results in scripts; direct display text unchanged.

patches.name: codemode-background
patches.description: Background codemode runs after a five-minute wait, partial output, completion events and cancellation.

patches.name: tool-load-append
patches.description: Mid-session tool additions preserve the initial prompt and append guidelines through structured system updates.

patches.name: cc-hidden-tool-names
patches.description: Lane OAuth Anthropic: o modelo chama tools pelo nome do Claude Code (Bash, Read). Quando a tool está escondida do request (codemode only), o nome volta em minúsculas em vez de dar 'Tool Bash not found'.

patches.name: auth-guidance-short
patches.description: Mensagens de falta de login/modelo/chave terminam em "Use /login to log into a provider via OAuth or API key.", sem "See:" nem os caminhos absolutos de docs/providers.md e docs/models.md; o diálogo de /login do Amazon Bedrock também perde o "See:" e o caminho de docs/providers.md.

patches.name: mcp-structured-content
patches.description: Chamada direta de tool MCP: quando o resultado tem blocos de conteúdo e structuredContent, e nenhum bloco de texto já é esse JSON, o modelo recebe também `structuredContent: <JSON compacto>`. Codemode inalterado.

win32.name: keeps a coalesced reload alive while another credential reader is waiting
win32.reason: upstream: reescreve auth.json com o mesmo tamanho e no NTFS a revisão (tamanho+mtime) não muda a tempo; falha 5 em 6 no Windows

win32.name: should include EACCES for read-only files
win32.reason: upstream: chmod read-only no NTFS gera EPERM, não EACCES

win32.name: should include EACCES in diff preview for unreadable files
win32.reason: upstream: chmod 000 não tira leitura no NTFS; o arquivo continua legível

win32.name: should treat flag-like patterns as search text
win32.reason: upstream: no grep o padrão '--pre=<caminho C:\...>' vira regex com '\U' inválido; rg recusa (sem executar nada, que é o que importa)

win32.name: bash uses ctx.cwd when provided
win32.reason: upstream: no Git Bash o pwd sai como /tmp/... e o teste compara com o caminho C:\...

commands: overlay/model-data/<version> + npm -w packages/ai run check:model-data (or hydrate-model-data with --hydrate)
npm run build:offline (npm run build with --hydrate)

bundleMarkers.name: mcp structured content for the model
